author: KEXP
description:
East Oakland legends Souls of Mischief deliver a lesson in hip-hop during our latest in-studio session. Live on KEXP with host Larry Mizell, Jr., the illustrious MCs share a performance of the 90s anthem "93 'Til Infinity" and more from across their catalog. 

Watch the full performance and interview on our listener-powered YouTube channel.
title: Souls of Mischief performs "93 'Til Infinity" & more Live on KEXP
